APPROVE
The extraction moves the inner loop into `NestControllerRoutes` with the same lazy iterator order, the same `t[i + 1]` class-name lookup (now via `classAt`), and an equivalent guard decision, while removing well over 23 complexity points from `Nest`; I couldn't find the source file to confirm that `classDecorators` is actually a `List<Decorator>`, so that parameter type is the one thing to check before merging.
